intents_zh: 寫一個 k8s CronJob 排程
排程 batch job 模板
code:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: {{job_name}}
  namespace: {{namespace}}
spec:
  schedule: "{{schedule}}"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: {{job_name}}
              image: {{image}}
              args:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - {{command_arg}}
summary_zh: CronJob 排程任務,Forbid 並行、保留近 3 次成功與 1 次失敗紀錄
